name: River Development Agent Production Execution Authority Composition Foundation
objective: Establish a deterministic, non-executing, fail-closed composition foundation that consumes the explicit DEV-321 production execution authority-input boundary and composes that preserved evidence through the existing execution-intelligence governance authorization, approval, controlled-execution, and controlled-executor authorization foundations to produce the existing RiverDevControlledExecutorOperationExecutionAuthorizationFoundation required by DEV-317, without creating new authorization semantics, broadening approved scope, treating execution intent as authorization, or performing repository mutation.
requirements: Consume an existing RiverDevProductionExecutionAuthorityInputBoundaryFoundation produced by DEV-321.
Require the DEV-321 authority-input boundary to be trusted, ready, and unblocked before authority evidence may progress.
Preserve the explicit human authorization evidence carried by DEV-321 without synthesizing, repairing, upgrading, or replacing it.
Preserve the explicit repository authorization evidence carried by DEV-321 without synthesizing, repairing, upgrading, or replacing it.
Preserve the approved execution scope carried by DEV-321 without broadening or replacing it.
Preserve the explicit governance approval evidence carried by DEV-321 without synthesizing, repairing, upgrading, or replacing it.
Preserve requestedMode as execution intent only and never treat requested apply mode as authorization.
Compose authority evidence only through existing authorization semantics and existing governance foundation constructors.
Preserve the existing authorization-boundary to approval-boundary to controlled execution dependency direction.

Preserve existing execution-boundary, execution-control, execution-runtime, execution-dispatch, execution-handoff, executor-admission, and controlled-executor authorization semantics where those stages are required by the existing constructor chain.
Do not manufacture DEV-317 acquisition input from RiverDevOperationalExecutorIntegrationEntryAuthorization.
Do not reverse the DEV-317 to DEV-318 to DEV-319 authorization dependency direction.

Fail closed when DEV-321 authority evidence or any required existing predecessor foundation is absent, invalid, untrusted, unauthorized, unapproved, uncontrolled, not ready, blocked, or otherwise unusable.
Do not bypass DEV-314, which remains the final operational executor integration entry boundary.
Do not grant commit, push, deployment, shell, network, secret-access, arbitrary repository mutation, or scope-expansion authority.
Perform exact constructor-contract inspection before selecting implementation files.
invariants: DEV-321 remains the authoritative explicit production authority-input boundary.
Requested apply mode is never authorization.
DEV-322 does not create human authorization evidence.
DEV-322 does not create repository authorization evidence.
DEV-322 does not create governance approval evidence.
DEV-322 does not broaden approved execution scope.
DEV-322 does not create new authorization semantics.
DEV-322 does not infer authority from execution intent.
DEV-322 does not adapt backward from downstream DEV-314 authorization.
The resulting controlled operation-execution authorization remains inert authorization data until consumed through the existing DEV-317, DEV-318, DEV-319, and DEV-314 chain.
No repository mutation or external side effect occurs inside DEV-322.
qualityGates: The exact DEV-321 output contract is proven from source.
The exact existing governance authorization-boundary input contract is proven from source.
The exact existing governance approval-boundary input contract is proven from source.
The exact controlled execution predecessor chain is proven from source.
The exact buildControlledExecutorOperationExecutionAuthorizationFoundation input contract is proven from source.
The exact RiverDevGovernedOperationExecutionAuthorizationAcquisitionInput executionAuthorization requirement is proven from source.
A single forward-only composition path from DEV-321 authority evidence to the existing controlled operation-execution authorization is identified.
No new authorization decision semantics are invented.
No production caller is modified during DEV-322 specification and constructor-contract discovery.
Repository working scope remains DEV-322 specification-only during discovery.
Nothing is staged, committed, pushed, or deployed during specification creation.
discoveryBasis: DEV-321 establishes an explicit production authority-input boundary carrying human authorization, repository authorization, approved scope, governance approval evidence, and requested execution mode.
DEV-321 intentionally does not create execution authorization.
The existing governance execution boundary consumes an approved governance boundary and fails closed when that boundary is not trusted and approved.
The existing governance execution-control foundation consumes the controlled execution boundary and fails closed when it is not trusted and controlled.
The existing governance execution-runtime foundation requires trusted, controlled, authorized, unblocked execution-control state and preserved execution-request evidence.
Existing dispatch, handoff, and executor-admission foundations preserve forward-only fail-closed execution governance.
DEV-319 orchestration currently has declaration-only production reachability.
DEV-321 authority-input establishment currently has declaration-only production reachability.
The next implementation must compose these existing semantics before production caller integration can safely occur.
nextStep: Implement the deterministic, non-executing DEV-322 production execution authority composition foundation and focused tests within the approved four-file scope, composing trusted DEV-321 authority evidence forward through the existing governance authorization, approval, controlled-execution, and controlled-executor authorization constructors without creating new authorization semantics or executing repository operations.
